risk: Carrier change window is late or missed
early_warning: No confirmed ticket 5 business days before
mitigation: Book windows at wave planning; agree an emergency change path; rehearse roll-back

risk: Cisco logic nobody remembers is missed in the rebuild
early_warning: Requirements workshops find 'we always did X' items late
mitigation: Rebuild from requirements; observe live calls; shadow period; parallel run on low-risk numbers

early_warning: Low pass rate in the training assessment
mitigation: Role-based training; floor walkers; hypercare; keep Cisco open for roll-back until stable

early_warning: Daily numbers differ between old and new
mitigation: Agree report definitions before the pilot; run both for one week

early_warning: API p95 above 2 s in test
mitigation: Timeouts under Studio's limit; fail modes decided per call; load test before wave 3

risk: A catastrophe event lands in a cutover window
mitigation: Change freeze rule: no cutover when a severe weather warning is active; CAT switch tested in wave 1

risk: Personal data reaches logs or recordings
early_warning: Any hit in the log search
mitigation: Keypad capture masked; no PII in logs by code and test; recording policy reviewed

risk: Material service provider obligations not met (APRA CPS 230)
early_warning: Register entry or exit plan missing at wave 1
mitigation: Register entry, notification, exit plan and tolerance levels before the pilot (verify current wording)

early_warning: High jitter in the network test
mitigation: Test from real sites; QoS; softphone settings

risk: Vendor AI behaves differently after an update
early_warning: Eval results change after a release
mitigation: Fixed eval set run before and after each change; version-pinned guardrail
